brief.aim: The table pairs 22 MFCC acoustic features of segmented frog calls with a fine-grained taxonomic label, so the evident study is classifying call to one of the 10 observed species (multiclass); Family and Genus are coarser taxonomic parents derived from the same annotation and would leak the species label, and RecordID must be grouped so calls from one recording never span train and test.
brief.repeated_subjects: Multiple calls from the same recording; RecordID repeats across thousands of rows and calls from one recording share acoustic conditions.
brief.unit: One segmented anuran call (a 22-dimensional MFCC feature vector extracted from a single vocalization)
